lines: Where doing-mind-measures fail, on the narrow step — spreading wide, then drawing in by its own gleams —
she who saps the stationed sun entire: draw hard, thin my difference, free me from world-fear.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sphāraṃ nijanijarucā saṃharati yā | iyaṃ mārta.ṅdasya sthitipadayujaḥ sāram akhilam

verses.craft: Sun-sapped entire; draw-hard-thin-free triple imperative; mārtāṇḍa normalization recorded per UNC.
